look_here_first: Look at leaf form and the flower stalk together: emergent leaves are usually ovate to linear-ovate rather than arrow-lobed, while submerged leaves can be narrow bladeless-looking phyllodes. On the inflorescence, female flowers are below the male flowers.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: aquatic perennial with corms and stolons

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: strong aquatic heterophylly: narrow submerged phyllodes vs broader emergent blades

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: rough spherical fruiting heads of many beaked achenes

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Submerged leaves may be sessile flattened phyllodes; emergent leaves have long triangular petioles and linear-ovate to ovate blades.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Emergent raceme with several whorls; pistillate flowers occupy lower positions and staminate flowers upper positions.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Spherical heads of numerous small beaked achenes.
